channel.title: Quantum News | Quantum Research Center
channel.description: Quantum news and explainers for curious readers.

item.title: Exponential Time Hypothesis collapses
item.description: A beginner’s guide to the Exponential Time Hypothesis, how the algorithm OpenAI has released is claimed to work, which results it overturns and which survive, and why it is a statement about growth rates rather than a faster SAT solver.

item.title: Quantum-safe security starts with ordinary computers
item.description: Why preparing for quantum computers means changing the mathematics behind digital security.

item.title: India’s National Quantum Mission, explained
item.description: Computing is one part of a programme spanning communication, sensing, and the materials behind quantum devices.

item.title: Beyond the qubit count: how to read a quantum computing headline
item.description: A bigger processor is only part of the story. Reliability and the work a machine can actually perform matter too.
